info.description: Raw rich text content — escape hatch for any custom content

content_v2.description: Lightly-formatted text with bold / italic / headings / lists / links. Not for pasting full HTML — for a whole HTML page use Custom HTML Landing (Content Manager → Custom HTML Landing), which gives you a /campaigns/ URL and supports image tokens. Select text and click the link icon to add a hyperlink.

style.description: Optional background colour, text colour, padding, alignment, max width, and background image for this section. Leave any field blank to use defaults.
